newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss inflation rises 0.3 pct in August vs July.
newsitem.headline: Swiss inflation rises 0.3 pct in August vs July.

text.p: Swiss consumer prices rose 0.3 percent in August from July for a year-on-year inflation rate of 0.6 percent, the Federal Statistics Office said.
Monthly CPI index change +0.3 pct -0.1 pct +0.3 pct

The Swiss Federal Statistics Office said the increase of 0.3 percent in August versus July was mainly due to a rise in the index series "other products and services," which showed a gain of 0.2 percent. The main factor in this category boosting prices was an increase in the cost of package tours. Indices for rent and energy, and transportation and communication, rose, while the index for clothing and shoes was steady.
Prices of foodstuffs, beverages and tobacco products fell, mainly due to seasonal factors affecting fruit and vegetable prices. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
